A $83.5M gain from changes in fair value of stock purchase warrant liabilities was the primary driver of the quarter's $93.98M increase in other income, net.

: Recorded a $56.6M impairment, including $41.3M related to Star and $15.4M related to Nimbus.
: Revenue reflects goods sales and integration projects involving tactical vehicles and trailers.
: Received $6.6M in net proceeds from the second closing of the February 2026 private placement on October 22.
